walls.note: The sculpture seen from the east-north-east at 9-13 m (perspective render artifacts/landmark-lanes/lensbomen/pano/v526.jpg, north-centred equirectangular). All three trees, five lenses visible.

items.where: three tapered near-black bronze trunks, about 0.65 m across at the flared foot, forking at about 2.5-2.7 m; the back one (B) leans east

items.how: taperedTube(): 8-sided Bezier tube, radius 0.34 to 0.19 m

items.where: ten curved horn-like branches tapering to points: four on A (tall outer horn to 7 m, inner horn, low outer horn, long arm towards the middle), three on B, three on C

items.where: six round perspex lenses about 0.9-1.0 m across in steel rims, held between the branches at 3.3-4.7 m, facing different ways
